items.title: A section vanishing on an open containing the associated points vanishes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-coherent F on a locally Noetherian scheme X with Ass(F) contained in an open U, the restriction map Gamma(X, F) -> Gamma(U, F) is injective (source lines 198-204). The proof follows the weakly associated companion with Ass in place of WeakAss: it forms the image F' of the section map, notes Supp(F') misses U, uses that Ass(F') is contained in Ass(F) and in Supp(F') so that Ass(F') is empty, and applies the vanishing lemma for modules with no associated points.
